**Verification and guards.** PR subject comes from the spec's `## Rework record`, never from an open PR. PR #42 is OPEN on `fix-timeout`, with base `main`.

| Spec | Verification set | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Lint/format header | test-timeout, test-retry, lint, format | Skip: passed at C; clean outside telemetry |
| `none - PR subject, scoped` header | test-timeout, test-retry | Skip |
| Ordinary spec | test-all | Standard 5-option menu, even with an open PR |

**Aliases:** P=`aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` (P7=`aaaaaaa`), M=`bbbbbbb`, C=`ccccccc`, D=`ddddddd`.

```bash
git -C "$WORKTREE" fetch origin
git -C "$WORKTREE" merge-base --is-ancestor $P HEAD
git -C "$WORKTREE" merge-base --is-ancestor origin/fix-timeout HEAD
git -C "$WORKTREE" log --first-parent --format=%h --grep '<Tn>' $M..HEAD
git -C "$WORKTREE" rm "$PLAN_PATH" && git -C "$WORKTREE" commit -m "Remove ephemeral plan doc"
node <bin>/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs --worktree "$WORKTREE" --option pr --base origin/main --spec doc/specs/rework.md  # nonzero: quote, stop, no push
git -C "$WORKTREE" update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42 $P
git -C "$WORKTREE" push --no-follow-tags origin HEAD:refs/heads/fix-timeout
gh pr view 42 --repo acme/widget --json body
SCRATCH=$(mktemp)   # outside repo: body bytes exactly, blank line, block
gh pr edit 42 --repo acme/widget --body-file "$SCRATCH"
```

```

1. Push to the PR branch (PR #42, fix-timeout; appends the rework block to its description)
2. Push and create a Pull Request (PR #42 already exists on this branch; gh refuses a second one)

Which option?
```

**Body after row 1:**

```markdown
Original description

## Rework

Before: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa (local ref `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42` in the rework checkout; the SHA is the portable handle and stays on origin because the push was not forced)
Spec: doc/specs/rework.md at <HEAD7>
Keeps: retry behavior
Changes: repair timeout
Dropped claims: none
Verification: scoped - test-timeout, test-retry, lint, format; CI on this push holds the full run. Telemetry: whole PR against main.
Threads:
- <T1 location> - fixed in ddddddd
- <T2 location> - fixed (task "<title>" complete; no single commit names T2)
- <T3 location> - fixed (task "<title>" complete; no single commit names T3)
- <T4–T6, T8 locations> - still open
- <T7 location> - declined - incompatible API
```

- **Thread reasons:**
  - T4 is incomplete, so its naming commit and file touch do not prove completion.
  - T5 has no task, so a path match does not count.
  - T6 was recorded keep open, and T8 is new.
  - T9 is omitted because it has since resolved.
- **Fetch outcomes:**
  - An empty fetch gives `Threads: none`.
  - A failed fetch gives `Threads: not fetched (<reason>)`.
- **All original claims dropped:** the block's second line becomes `supersedes the description above`. `Dropped claims:` then lists one `No longer true: <claim>` line per claim.
- **Sentinel header:** the Verification line reads `scoped - test-timeout, test-retry`.

| Checkpoint | Delta |
|---|---|
| 2. Origin not an ancestor of HEAD | Omit row 1. Under the list: `Withheld: push - push withheld: origin/fix-timeout is at <O7>, local HEAD at <H7>; a non-force push cannot land`. Rows 2-6 map to Options 1-5. |
| 2. P versus origin | P proven an ancestor of origin: append `(origin moved past the rework's base aaaaaaa)`. Not an ancestor: append nothing. Divergence alone proves nothing. |
| 2. Bare replies on withheld menu | `1`: ask a clarifying question naming 2-6. `5`: Keep, nothing pushed. `6`: Discard after typed `discard` confirmation; origin branch untouched. |
| 3. Stops | P not an ancestor: `PR branch history was rewritten: aaaaaaa is not an ancestor of HEAD; the rework must be re-merged, not rebased.` |
| 3. Other stops | Missing prehead: stop naming `doc/specs/rework.md`. CLOSED: `PR #42 is CLOSED; the rework cannot be pushed to it.` Wrong head: stop naming both branches. Exit 128: command error, stop with its output. |
| 4. Push rejected | Report once. No body edit, no retry, no force. Return to menu; worktree preserved. |

| 5. Evidence | test-retry fails: stop before menu return. All pass: commit `whole-diff minors fix`, re-audit in Step 3.5 (`whole-diff minors fix: <SHA>`), re-render menu. Later `fix minors` gets "minors round already spent". Ordinary spec: test-all, header-only dispatch. |

**Shared guards.** PR record—not an existing PR—selects PR mode. OPEN/head/base match. Verification union: `lint`, `format`, `test-timeout`, `test-retry`. Clean-tree checks against `ccccccc` permit skipping. Header `none - PR subject, scoped` retains both task tests. Ordinary spec uses `test-all`, regardless of an open PR. Conformance: CONFORMS; whole-diff minors: not recorded. No amendments.

4. Squash-merge to main (no PR, no surviving branch; orphans PR #42 - close it by hand)
5. Keep the branch as-is (I'll handle it later; nothing is pushed)

**1. Row 1 simulation.** Aliases: `W=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-timeout`, `P=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`, `M=bbbbbbb`, `V=ccccccc`, `D=ddddddd`; `H`, `O` denote observed local/origin SHA7s.

Capture accepted-complete task/thread evidence before stripping; refetch threads, omitting resolved T9. Then:

```sh
# Strip tracked plan; commit removal.
node "$BIN/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs" --worktree "$W" --option pr --base origin/main --spec doc/specs/rework.md
# Any nonzero: quote seal error; STOP, no push.
git -C "$W" update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42 "$P"
```

Append locations and resolutions: T1 `fixed in $D`; T2/T3 `fixed (task "<title>" complete; no single commit names <id>)`; T4/T5/T6/T8 `still open`; T7 `declined - incompatible API`. T4’s naming commit/file touch and T5’s path match prove nothing. Naming commits count first-parent after `$M`. Empty fetch: `Threads: none`; failure: `Threads: not fetched (<reason>)`. All claims dropped: second line `supersedes the description above`; list each `No longer true: <claim>`.

**2. Divergence.** Omit row 1; retain labels 2–6. Under list: `Withheld: push - origin/fix-timeout is at $O, local HEAD at $H; a non-force push cannot land`. Proven `$P` ancestor of origin adds `(origin moved past the rework's base aaaaaaa)`; false adds nothing.

Bare `1`: ask for 2–6. `5`: keep worktree/branch. `6`: list commits/worktree/branch; require exact `discard`; never delete origin. Rows 2–6 map to Options 1–5. Recompute preflight.

**3. Stops.** Nonancestor prehead: `PR branch history was rewritten: aaaaaaa is not an ancestor of HEAD; the rework must be re-merged, not rebased.` Missing prehead names `doc/specs/rework.md`; CLOSED stops rework; wrong head names both branches. Exit 128 reports command error, never divergence.

**4. Failures.** Rejected push: report once, no body edit/retry/force; return menu. Body failure: retain push, print manual block and error. Preserve worktree; no thread replies, merge, or ticket changes. Successful completion prints seal stdout and completes ship.

**5. Independent F3 runs.** Dispatch implementer with F3 verbatim, worktree cwd, commands `lint`, `format`, `test-timeout`, `test-retry` under either header. Failed `test-retry` or missing evidence blocks return. All passing: commit `whole-diff minors fix`, re-audit, record spent-round SHA, re-render; no code review. Ordinary spec dispatches only `test-all`.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After delivers the PR-subject finishing contract that Before declared unspecified: the six-row menu with PR consequences, the task-union verification with sentinel handling, the spec-naming missing-prehead stop, withheld-row treatment with ancestry-proven suffix and the 1/5/6 reply mapping, the refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42 save plus --no-follow-tags non-force push after strip and seal, thread evidence captured (the grep precedes the plan rm) with fixed-in/fallback/open/declined/omitted renderings, and the fresh-fetched body with Rework block and supersedes rule. Nothing Before held was lost; failures was already satisfied in Before and remains so. Two wordings worth tightening so they cannot be misread: 'Rows 2-6 map to Options 1-5' could suggest renumbering rather than rows 2-6 keeping their numbers while mapping to the standard options (say 'rows keep numbers 2-6, mapping to standard options 1-5'), and the F3 evidence row should state explicitly that missing post-fix evidence for any command, not only a failing test-retry, blocks menu return.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After delivers the PR-subject finish almost entirely: the six-row menu with consequences, withheld-row treatment with both SHAs and the proven-ancestry suffix, named stops, --no-follow-tags non-force push to refs/heads/fix-timeout, the pre-rework ref, fresh body fetch with exact bytes plus blank line and the Rework block, T2/T3 complete-task fallback, and the superseding rule. The one fact it does not settle is verification, and only in the F3 section: 'commands lint, format, test-timeout, test-retry under either header' says the sentinel header still dispatches lint and format, whereas the contract makes the sentinel header dispatch only the task union (test-timeout, test-retry) and never the sentinel. Reword to something like 'under the lint/format header dispatch lint, format, test-timeout, test-retry; under the sentinel header dispatch only test-timeout and test-retry (never `none`)'. Also make the ordinary-spec menu count explicit ('ordinary spec keeps the five-option menu even with an open PR') rather than relying on 'Rows 2–6 map to Options 1–5' and the verification sentence to imply it. Before already held failures, and After keeps that, so no regression there.
